meta.desc: Cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the (1) Sage before 1.3.10, and (2) Sage++ extensions for Firefox, allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via a "<SCRIPT/=''SRC='" sequence in an RSS feed, a different vulnerability than CVE-2006-4712.
